description: What the creators you watch have posted since you last checked. Fetches each one's recent posts and compares them against the snapshot taken at your last catch-up, then moves the snapshot forward — so this answers 'what is new' rather than 'what exists'. The first run for a creator has nothing to compare against and just records the baseline. Consumes 2 nooticr credits per creator checked. Use when the user asks what the creators they watch have posted since the last check.
